en: Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor has an internal object, a state that is a cause and has an internal object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor has an external object, a state that is a cause and has an external object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
(There is no [state] with both internal and external objects.)
